messages:
nina (compliance): Kickoff: monthly admin-entitlement cull. Need evidence bundle + canary plan. Tue 09:30 PT preferred.

rob (sec-eng): I can do KMS grant review and rebind notes. Flagged pattern: cross-account principals that should map to redwood-deploy-svcacct.

amal (infra): Current cloud log retention = 90d. I can enable export to S3 with 1y retention; will schedule during Tue morning maintenance window. Command example: aws logs create-export-task --task-name export-admin --from 0 --to 9999999999 --log-group-name /aws/redwood/prod --destination redwood-audit-bucket

dave (sre): Dry-run heuristic: roles with owners=[] and lastUsed < 180d => candidate. Will post CSV dry-run and label items: keep/shelve/remove. Shelve = revoke perms but keep role for 30d.

audit-bot: export started types=[iam_snapshot,kms_grants,last_365d_activity] output=s3://redwood-audit/1739991022-bundle.tar.gz ETA=3m

rob (sec-eng): For any key with external grants we'll create a rebind PR: revoke external principal, grant redwood-deploy-limited, run decrypt smoke.

nina (compliance): Great. Action list: amal -> export sink, dave -> dry-run CSV, rob -> rebind playbook + smoke tests, I'll open tracker and collect attestations.

audit-bot: export complete. Summary: ownerless=7, cross_account_kms=2, stale_keys=0. Evidence: s3://redwood-audit/1739991022-bundle.tar.gz :white_check_mark:

nina (compliance): Thanks team 97 will assign owners in the ticket and set canary controls.
